STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in `style.css`. **The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden everywhere.** - All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class selectors (BEM, Section 4). - HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic: changing the look must never require markup edits. - JavaScript must never write to `element.style` or inject style attributes — **all visual change happens via class toggles only**. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define every token in `:root` (light) and override under `.dark`. Verify all text/background pairs meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text/UI); adjust derived tones only within the palette family if a pair fails. Never default a light surface to `#ffffff` — if a near-white is needed, use `#fefefe`. - **Neumorphism guardrails:** every raised component also defines a pressed/inset counterpart (`:active`, accordion-open, featured states). All neumorphic surfaces carry a 1px `--border-default` so edges never vanish in dark mode. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** - Light is the default hero theme; dark tokens are defined under the `.dark` class applied to `` by JS. - **Theme switching:** a visible toggle button in the header swaps themes by toggling `.dark` only — no HTML restructuring. - **Persistence:** store the choice in `localStorage` (e.g. key `enigma-theme`); on first visit with no stored value, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. The toggle must reflect state via `aria-pressed` and a descriptive `aria-label` ("Toggle dark mode"), and swap its Material icon (`light_mode` / `dark_mode`). - Theme initialization happens in `script.js` on `DOMContentLoaded`; add no inline scripts. **1.4 Layout: CSS Grid + Flexbox (Mobile-First)** - Use **CSS Grid** for section scaffolding (12-column desktop grid inside a max-width ~72rem container; sections collapse gracefully via `auto-fit`/`minmax` or explicit media queries at ~640px / 768px / 1024px). - Use **Flexbox** for every component interior. Every flex container must default to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment. - Mobile-first: multi-column rows (hero, features, steps, pricing, testimonials) collapse to single columns on small viewports. **No horizontal scrolling at any width down to 320px.** All primary targets ≥ 44×44px. **1.5 Styling Approach** - Vanilla hand-authored CSS in `style.css` (see exception clause in the Design Brief). Organize with native CSS `@layer` (tokens → base/reset → components → utilities). No preprocessors, no CDN frameworks, no arbitrary magic numbers repeated across rules — reuse tokens. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Only)** - Load via `` with `preconnect` and `&display=swap`: **Space Grotesk** (headings, 600–700), **Inter** (body, 400–500), **IBM Plex Mono** (rotor labels, stats, prices, badges, cipher output). - Icons: **Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** via the standard stylesheet, using `font-variation-settings` for fill/weight as needed. **Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.** Decorative icons are `aria-hidden="true"`; functional icons carry accessible labels. --- ## 2.
